content:
“You're a close-quarters gun warrior!”

**Guerrilla Master** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

+5 max Onslaught stacks. +5% ranged damage to close enemies per Onslaught stack.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 3 | +5% ranged damage to close enemies per Onslaught stack, +5 max stacks. | 0031AF08 | 

- Although the perk card art for Guerrilla Master depicts a MAC-11 pistol, this weapon is not available in the game.
- Before Update 58 Guerilla Master was called "Master Guerilla," and it provided 10%/15%/20% more damage to automatic pistols per rank.
- The definition of "close" is unclear.
